'''Legacy''' may refer to:

* [[Virtual Legacy]], the Players Committee virtual card pool from the 2009 Block reorganization through the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]]
* [[Legacy Open]], the constructed format of Decipher cards plus that pool (GEMP code <code>legacy</code>)
* [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], the Legacy Virtual-era rulebook (redirect [[Legacy Virtual Advanced Rulebook]])
* [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy]], the first numbered Original Virtual Set
